local_checks.invariant: No anon-callable filter or RPC lets a small request cause work beyond what direct anon REST access to the same public tables already allows, which is the comparable Supabase anon+RLS baseline.

x_hardening: ilikeTerm (src/domain/core.mjs:16) strips only ( ) *. Commas and double quotes in a user's own search term (e.g. 'Rio, Niterói' in hero search, searchLines, Portarias text, or Localidades) survive percent-decoding and split the or=() logic tree. The result is a PostgREST 400 or a self-broadened query. The scope is the visitor's own request and is reachable directly via REST, so this is not a security finding. Fix: emit each logic-tree value double-quoted with \\ and \" escaped, e.g. col.ilike."*term*", or strip , " \\ in ilikeTerm. Add a tests/ case for ilikeTerm('a,b') and orIlike(['c'],['a,b']).

ilike wildcards % and _ are not escaped (ilikeTerm and the divat_busca_logradouro termo). Terms shorter than 3 characters or made only of wildcards defeat the pg_trgm GIN indexes and force seq scans; divat_busca_logradouro also calls f_unaccent per row. The anon 3s timeout and LIMIT early termination bound this. For predictable cost, enforce a minimum term length and escape % and _ (\\% and \\_).

divat_linhas_regiao (docs/backup_schema.sql:343-362, live definition not in migrations) aggregates the whole itinerario_teste table (GROUP BY codlinha with an array_agg ordered by id) on every anon call, regardless of p_regiao or p_modo. db_max_rows caps rows returned, not work done. A precomputed per-codlinha table, refreshed on import, would turn the anon RPC into an index lookup.

sbFetch (src/data/rest.mjs:75-93) retries HTTP 500, including PostgREST 57014 statement-timeout errors, plus 429 and the 20s AbortError, up to 2 times with fixed backoff and no jitter. A deterministic timeout therefore costs up to 3x DB time per visitor action exactly when the shared DB is degraded (check-01 [4]). Retry only 502, 503, 504 and 429 with jitter, and never when the body code is 57014.

The anon 3s, authenticator 8s and pgrst.db_max_rows=30000 settings exist only in the historical baseline docs/backup_schema.sql:783-787, not in supabase/migrations, and no gate verifies them (scripts/check_grants.mjs covers grants only). The owner should periodically confirm `select rolname, rolconfig from pg_roles where rolname in ('anon','authenticated','authenticator')` and consider adding it to the daily db-checks job. Raw anon request volume against the shared pool remains the documented accepted residual risk SEC-02 (docs/seguranca.md:132-135).

The codempresa_teste Realtime invalidator (src/data/lookups.mjs:122) re-fetches the full company table immediately on every event, with no debounce or in-flight sharing. A bulk owner write of K rows therefore triggers K concurrent full-table GETs per connected visitor, and each GET can be retried up to 3 times. Fix: memoize the in-flight getEmpresas promise and fold the refetch into the existing 350 ms debounce.

sbFetch (src/data/rest.mjs:69-98) retries 5xx, 429, timeouts and network errors twice with a fixed 400/800 ms backoff. It adds no jitter and ignores Retry-After. The multiplier is bounded (x3), but it is synchronized across all visitors during DB saturation (anon statement_timeout produces 500s). Consider adding jitter, honoring Retry-After, and not retrying 429.

The Realtime channel uses a fixed, public, predictable topic 'divat-rt' (app.js:1611, private:false). Any holder of the anon key can join and broadcast to every visitor's socket. The vendored client drops these messages because the portal has no broadcast or presence bindings, so there is no control effect. The deliveries still count against the project's Realtime message and rate quotas. The owner can check the Realtime 'Allow public access' setting in the dashboard, or use a per-client random topic name or a private channel.

window.__divatReload (app.js:1082,1652) is a window global that markup with id="__divatReload" could override (DOM clobbering); the only effect is a page reload when the modal closes. Use a module-scoped variable.

x_hardening: scripts/check_migrations.mjs false negatives (artifacts/evidence-02.txt). The gate accepts role-membership GRANTs (GRANT service_role/pg_write_all_data TO anon|authenticated, GRANT anon TO <role>), public tables spelled CREATE UNLOGGED TABLE / "public"."x" / unqualified / ALTER TABLE … SET SCHEMA public, ALTER TABLE … DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, ALTER FUNCTION public.* SECURITY DEFINER, CREATE VIEW public.* without security_invoker over staging tables, ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES … IN SCHEMA private GRANT … TO anon, and a function REVOKE not bound to the created signature. Fix: reject any role GRANT whose grantee or granted role is anon/authenticated/public/service_role/pg_*; normalise quotes and unqualified names before matching table creation and SET SCHEMA public; reject DISABLE RLS, SECURITY DEFINER in public and views without security_invoker=true; scope read grants and default-privilege changes by schema; bind the REVOKE to the created signature. Add each fixture as a recusa() case in tests/migrations-contract.test.mjs. The owner applies migrations and the daily check_grants catches most public-schema cases after application, so this is a reviewer-aid gap.

SECURITY DEFINER hygiene in schema audit. Before ALTER FUNCTION … SECURITY DEFINER, assert that proconfig pins search_path, preferably to pg_catalog, pg_temp with schema-qualified bodies. This matters most for audit.divat_security_digest(), whose DDL is not versioned (20260822151732:28; 20260824015915:13). Version its DDL, and extend divat_security_shape/check_phase3_audit to report owner, prosecdef, proconfig and ACL for functions in audit and private.

divat_auditor_ci is constrained only on the client side. Read-only mode comes from PGOPTIONS in scripts/lib/audit-database.mjs:131, and the role has no server-side limits. Add ALTER ROLE divat_auditor_ci SET default_transaction_read_only=on, SET statement_timeout, and CONNECTION LIMIT. In scripts/bootstrap_phase3_auditor.sql, assert that the role's memberships are exactly {divat_auditor}: the ALTER ROLE rotation path keeps any pre-existing memberships, and the check at :46 tests only one table. Avoid sending a plaintext PASSWORD in DDL (use psql \password or a SCRAM verifier). Prefer sslmode=verify-full with the provider CA over the accepted require (audit-database.mjs:37).

If it ran successfully, it would re-grant the diagnostic RPCs and f_unaccent to anon and authenticated and SELECT on 14 tables to authenticated, contradicting 20260930172521. attack_class: Edge/runtime boundary mismatch / build-context inclusion / clickjacking

local_checks.invariant: The published file set contains only intended public assets and no credential or private configuration (build-context inclusion).
local_checks.result: Rendered the allowlist with git the same way tests/check.js does: 383 tracked files, 346 excluded, 37 published (index.html, app.js, styles.css, manifest, vercel.json, version.json, 17 src modules, 15 vendor assets). No untracked working-tree file would ship through the CLI/MCP upload path. Every sampled internal file is excluded: CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json, .codex/config.toml, workflows, docs/backup_schema.sql, tests, scripts, .claude/settings.json, supabase/migrations. The only credential-shaped content published is the anon JWT in app.js (role=anon, ref=gontnlfmothfglssbyyk), which is public by design. There are no postgres URIs, sb_secret_, service_role, private keys, age secrets, GitHub tokens or bypass references.

local_checks.invariant: Framing protection and the CSP cover every path. A missing header would matter only if there were a state-changing framed action.
local_checks.result: The single rule `source: /(.*)` sets X-Frame-Options DENY and a CSP with frame-ancestors 'none', script-src 'self', style-src-attr 'none', object-src 'none', base-uri 'self' and form-action 'self', without unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval, plus HSTS and nosniff. The portal is read-only with no login or state-changing action. index.html loads only same-origin app.js, styles.css and the manifest. No service worker is registered and the manifest declares no scope. So there is no clickjacking path and no service-worker-scope path.

local_checks.invariant: No edge or serverless path and no per-environment overlay changes authority or weakens headers between production and previews.
local_checks.result: There is no api/ directory, middleware, functions, package.json or build step, and any such file would be excluded by the `/*` default-deny. One vercel.json serves production and every preview. The only per-host switch (app.js:170-182, SITE_USA_TESTE_TEMPORARIAMENTE with HOSTS_PROD) sends every host to the same public anon endpoint, so no host gains different authority. The local rig serves the CSP read from vercel.json (rig.mjs:63). tests/check.js §[1] fails a build when a required asset is not published. scripts/check_deploy.mjs re-asserts the served headers (149-189) and the 404 of internal files (274-287) on each deployment.
